title: Add TP heartbeat metrics + stall detectors (compute vs comms vs scheduler starvation)
creator: Noah Patel
description:
Context
- We have multiple TP hang signatures in the wild (and at least one Sev1) where the request appears “in-flight” but we can’t tell quickly whether we’re wedged in compute, NCCL collectives, or scheduler starvation (prefill-heavy batches starving decode/collective ordering).
- Goal of this ticket is to add low-overhead, actionable metrics + trace/log annotations so on-call and runtime engineers can:
  (1) detect TP stalls early (before p99 explosions / autoscaling thrash)
  (2) classify stalls (compute vs comms vs scheduler) consistently
  (3) correlate stalls to replica/rank + in-flight collective state + scheduler backlog.

Scope
1) Per-rank heartbeat
- Emit a monotonic “I’m making progress” heartbeat per TP rank during: prefill step, decode step, and collective boundaries.
- Heartbeat must be present even when requests are streaming (decode loop) so we can detect a decode-iteration deadlock.

2) In-flight collective counters
- Counters/gauges that tell us:
  - last collective seq/id observed per rank
  - number of in-flight collectives per replica (and ideally per stream)
  - time since last collective completion

3) Scheduler queue depth + starvation signals
- Expose queue depth/backlog for prefill and decode queues, plus “collective pending” signals so we can detect when collectives are not being scheduled fairly.

4) Stall reason tagging
- A single “best-effort” classification emitted as:
  - metric label on a stall counter (for dashboards/alerts)
  - structured log event (for incident debugging)
  - trace span attributes (for correlation with request IDs)

Non-goals
- This ticket does not attempt to fix the underlying deadlocks (see ENG-4824 / ENG-4825 / ENG-4826). It provides observability + detection so we can prove fixes and catch regressions.

Proposed metrics (final names from eng-runtime + SRE review)
- runtime_tp_rank_heartbeat_seconds{cluster,env,replica_id,model,tp_rank,phase}
  - Gauge: unix timestamp (seconds) of last progress update.
  - phase ∈ {prefill,decode,collective,kv_compaction,unknown}

- runtime_tp_collective_inflight{cluster,env,replica_id,model,collective,tp_group_id}
  - Gauge: number of collectives currently “in-flight” for the replica.
  - collective ∈ {all_reduce,all_gather,reduce_scatter,broadcast,unknown}

- runtime_tp_collective_seq{cluster,env,replica_id,model,tp_rank,tp_group_id}
  - Gauge: last-seen collective sequence number per rank.

- runtime_scheduler_queue_depth{cluster,env,replica_id,queue}
  - Gauge: number of items in scheduler queues.
  - queue ∈ {prefill,decode,control,unknown}

- runtime_tp_stall_events_total{cluster,env,replica_id,model,reason}
  - Counter: increments when detector fires.
  - reason ∈ {comms_suspected,nccl_collective_stalled,scheduler_starvation,compute_stalled,kv_pressure,unknown}

Stall detector (v1) semantics
- Detector runs in runtime process (replica) and emits a stall event when:
  A) heartbeat gap > threshold AND there is active work (queue_depth>0 OR inflight_collective>0)
  B) collective seq has not advanced for > threshold while inflight_collective>0
  C) decode queue depth continues to grow while prefill dominates and collectives are pending (heuristic for starvation)

- Classification logic (best-effort):
  - If inflight_collective>0 and collective_seq not advancing -> nccl_collective_stalled
  - Else if queue_depth_decode>0 and prefill queue dominates and no collectives scheduled -> scheduler_starvation
  - Else if GPU util high but no heartbeat (rare) -> compute_stalled
  - Else if kv_pressure signals present (OOM near-misses / compaction loop) -> kv_pressure
  - Else -> unknown

Performance/overhead constraints
- Heartbeat updates must be O(1) and non-blocking; avoid per-token updates.
- Sampling for trace attributes to avoid cardinality blow-ups; metrics labels MUST NOT include request_id.
- replica_id is already high-cardinality, but we need it for Dedicated incident response; ensure dashboards can roll up by cluster/model.

Deliverables
- Runtime metrics + structured logs behind a feature flag where needed.
- Trace enrichment: span attributes for tp_rank + collective seq and a stall reason tag on the request span when present.
- Dashboard panels + initial alert rules (owned by SRE/observability pack, but this ticket provides metric contracts).

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Metrics emitted in Hosted + Dedicated runtimes without crashing when TP is disabled (should no-op or emit minimal).
- [x] During repro harness (ENG-4822), we can see heartbeat gap and inflight collective state for stuck replicas.
- [x] A single stuck replica produces a clear stall reason event + structured log including: replica_id, tp_group_id, tp_rank set, phase, collective seq, queue depths.
- [x] Traces show the stall reason tag and collective counters on spans (sampled), enabling correlation from request timeout -> replica -> stall signature.
- [x] Unit tests for metric emission + a small fault-injection test that forces “collective seq not advancing” path (best-effort).

Implementation notes
- Metrics library: use existing runtime stats registry; export via telemetry pipeline (coord: Logan Wright / Caleb Johnson).
- Structured logs: emit a single JSON log line per detector fire with a rate limit (e.g., max 1/min per replica per reason) to avoid incident spam.
- Coordinate label set with SRE (Aisha Bello / Sergio Costa) to ensure alertability and stable aggregation.

Rollout plan
- Land metrics first (default on).
- Detector event emission default on in canary clusters; alert rules initially in “ticket-only / non-paging” mode.
- After runtime-1.19 canary proves low noise, enable paging for sustained heartbeat gaps correlated with timeouts.

Notes / risks
- Potential for high-cardinality metrics if we include too many dimensions; keep labels constrained to cluster/env/replica_id/model/tp_rank/phase.
- False positives during legitimate long prefill for long-context prompts; detector thresholds must be workload-aware (see ENG-4826 for watchdog defaults).
comments: 2025-02-20 (Noah Patel): Creating as P0. We keep losing time in incidents debating “is it NCCL, scheduler, or compute?” We need metrics that answer this in <5 minutes. Please coordinate naming w/ SRE so alerts are straightforward.

2025-02-21 (Omar El-Sayed): Drafted metric names + label sets. Key decision: heartbeat is timestamp gauge (seconds) so alerting uses time() - gauge. Avoid request_id to keep cardinality sane. Will add structured log event with rate limit.

2025-02-22 (Aisha Bello): +1 on timestamp gauge. Please ensure replica_id label matches what on-call uses in pager payloads. For alerts, we want: “heartbeat_gap > X AND (inflight_collective>0 OR request_timeouts increasing)”. Also add dashboard rollups by model + cluster.

2025-02-23 (Allison Grant): For tracing, keep tp_rank/collective_seq as span attributes but sample aggressively; avoid attaching to every token span. Suggest: attach to request root span + one decode iteration span per N iterations.

2025-02-25 (Julian Moore): Added scheduler_queue_depth metrics hooks (prefill/decode/control). For starvation heuristic, we can compute a ratio in the detector (decode_depth growing while prefill_depth stays high). Will keep heuristic behind debug flag until we validate noise.

2025-02-26 (Omar El-Sayed): Opened PR redwood#21834 with metrics + stall reason enum + structured logs. Added basic unit tests around registry emission and label presence. Next: extend tracing spans with collective counters (separate PR).

2025-02-27 (Grace Kim): Reviewed PR. One concern: tp_rank label across all ranks may create many time series on 8-GPU+; acceptable for Dedicated but maybe heavy for Hosted. Suggest adding a config to aggregate heartbeat across ranks (min/avg) in Hosted if needed later.

2025-02-28 (Omar El-Sayed): Addressed review: added optional aggregated heartbeat metric runtime_tp_replica_heartbeat_seconds without tp_rank label (emitted always), kept per-rank behind config for Hosted. Also added log rate limiting (1/min/replica/reason).
2025-02-28 (Omar El-Sayed): Opened PR redwood#21872 to add collective counters to tracing spans (sampled). Linked dashboard updates to observability-pack#412.

2025-03-01 (Omar El-Sayed): Merged redwood#21834 and redwood#21872. Verified in perf-canary cluster: can reproduce mixed prefill/decode stall and see inflight_collective>0 + collective_seq not advancing + stall reason = nccl_collective_stalled. Marking done; follow-ups on alert tuning will live under ENG-4828 / SRE alerting thread.
